in_hebrew.name: מורה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who instructs or guides, a mentor, a teacher, or a leader. In the Bible, Moriah is the name of the mountain where Abraham was to offer Isaac as a sacrifice.

in_greek.name: Μώρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Proto-Greek word 'mor', meaning 'fame' or 'renown'. In Greek mythology, Mora is a personification of misfortune or calamity.

in_latin.name: Mora
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'morari', meaning 'to tarry' or 'to delay'. In Latin literature, Mora is personified as the goddess of delays and obstacles.
